text.p: - Authorities on the Bahamas have agreed to hand over ex-financier Werner Rey to Switzerland. Rey still can appeal the decision in higher courts.
- The Swiss government plans to slaughter 230,000 cows by mid- 1999 to restore confidence in the country's beef industry. The plan calls for destroying cattle starting in 1997.
- The Swiss government is making five million francs available for an international investigation into what happened to assets of Nazi victims, and how the Swiss dealt with assets belonging to Nazis.
- Roche and Bayer plan to jointly market some products in the U.S., pending approval of authorities.

- Swissair will launch a round of price cuts on fares to the U.S. The price for a Zurich-New York fare based on the period between October 21 to mid-December, round-trip, will be cut to 620 Swiss francs from a discount price of 921 francs.
